description: Covers unstructured text data ingestion, knowledge graph construction, frequent pattern mining, topic modeling with LDA, sentiment analysis, and text summarization.
learning_objectives: Collect, clean, normalize, and preprocess massive unstructured text corpora.
Construct knowledge graphs using entity linking and relationship extraction.
Mine frequent, closed, and sequential patterns from text data using Apriori and FP-Growth.
Perform text classification, topic modeling (LDA/BERTopic), sentiment analysis, and summarization.
outline: Text Mining Introduction: Overview, motivation, unstructured data challenges, data collection techniques.
Data Preprocessing: Tokenization, stemming, lemmatization, stopword filtering, regex cleaning, text normalization.
Knowledge Graphs & Information Extraction: Graph representations, entity linking, relationship extraction, knowledge graph embedding.
Pattern Mining: Frequent itemsets, closed patterns, max-patterns, association rules, Apriori algorithm, FP-Growth, sequential pattern mining.
Feature Extraction & Topic Modeling: Bag-of-Words, TF-IDF, word embeddings, Expectation-Maximization (EM), Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), BERTopic.
Applications & Case Studies: Sentiment analysis, aspect-based opinion mining, text summarization, end-to-end text analytics project.
